factors.name: 双倍快乐
factors.description: 敌人拥有双倍血量

factors.name: 元素异常
factors.description: 角色受到攻击时会被附加随机异常状态，冷却时间5秒
factors.descriptionEn: When you take a hit, a random debuff will be applied to you. The effect only triggers once every 5 seconds

factors.name: 脆皮
factors.description: 生命上限固定为1点

factors.name: 人海战术
factors.description: 敌人更加密集

factors.name: 双领主
factors.description: 你将同时面对两个领主，但领主会变得更弱一些
factors.descriptionEn: Fight with 2 slightly nerfed bosses in each Boss room

factors.name: 细胞分裂
factors.description: 怪物血量少于一半时自动分裂
factors.descriptionEn: Monsters split into two when their HP is below 50%

factors.name: 武器过热
factors.description: 发射类型的武器持续攻击会使得攻击速度变慢
factors.descriptionEn: The fire rate of weapons that discharge projectiles reduce after consecutive attacks

factors.name: 劣质药剂
factors.description: 从所有类型的恢复中获取的治疗数值都会减半

factors.name: 闪现的敌人
factors.description: 敌人受到伤害瞬移
factors.descriptionEn: Monsters shift to a different position the moment they get hit

factors.name: 坚强的敌人
factors.description: 敌人防御+1

factors.name: 亢奋的敌人
factors.description: 敌人子弹速度增加

factors.name: 狂野的敌人
factors.description: 敌人更具有攻击性

factors.name: 近视眼
factors.description: 可视范围受限

factors.name: 无知觉
factors.description: 功能性界面失去作用

factors.name: 梦游
factors.description: 地牢顺序被打乱

factors.name: 地牢扩建
factors.description: 增加地牢中房间的数量
factors.descriptionEn: Each level may contain an extra battle room

factors.name: 全面戒备
factors.description: 精英怪出现概率增加

factors.name: 跟踪激光
factors.description: 定期出现的激光将会跟踪角色，对角色和敌人都会造成伤害
factors.descriptionEn: A beam of laser appear regularly, tracking you and dealing damage to both you and your enemies

factors.name: 箱子突变
factors.description: 关卡内部分箱子将突变为特殊箱子
factors.descriptionEn: Some crates in levels will become special chests

factors.name: 瘴气弥漫
factors.description: 关卡内随机出现瘴气区域，角色在瘴气区域内能够隐身，同时不断叠加瘴气减益效果。瘴气减益效果叠满后会损伤生命值，离开瘴气区域后，瘴气减益效果将自动流失
factors.descriptionEn: Miasma area randomly appear in the levels. Staying inside the miasma area grant you invisibility but also inflicts you with miasma stacks...

factors.name: 精神的敌人
factors.description: 敌人所受负面效果时间减半

factors.name: 坏运气
factors.description: 坏运气

factors.name: 能量衰弱
factors.description: 最大能量衰弱

factors.name: 冷却翻倍
factors.description: 技能冷却时间增加100%

factors.name: 加价
factors.description: 地牢商品价格加倍

factors.name: 炸弹宝箱

factors.descriptionEn: Bombs and coins may spawn in chests when you clear a room

factors.name: 单武器
factors.description: 默认只能携带一把武器

factors.name: 孤勇者
factors.description: 不能携带宠物及佣兵

factors.name: 跑起来的敌人
factors.description: 敌人变快，但是偶尔会眩晕
factors.descriptionEn: Enemies move faster, but will be stunned from time to time

factors.description: 减少一个天赋位置，选择天赋时增加1个选项

factors.name: 硬壳守护

factors.descriptionEn: Better defense, but shield does not regenerate during combat

factors.name: 既视感
factors.description: 可能会遇到完全一样的关卡

factors.name: 时间流速不稳定
factors.description: 你的行动变得时快时慢

factors.descriptionEn: Weapons get reforged at the start of each level

factors.description: 武器的暴击率加倍，暴击伤害减半

factors.name: 巨大化

factors.name: 缩小隧道
factors.description: 角色体型变小，降低生命和护甲，增加移动速度
factors.descriptionEn: Become smaller and lose health and armor, but move faster

factors.name: 肌肉强化术
factors.description: 武器的攻击力加倍，但攻击速度减半

factors.name: 攻速强化术
factors.description: 武器攻击速度加倍，但伤害减半

factors.name: 天降神兵
factors.description: 每进入一个新场景可以获得一把武器
factors.descriptionEn: Get a weapon when entering a new biome

factors.name: 驯兽师
factors.description: 每进入一个新场景可以获得一个坐骑
factors.descriptionEn: A mount awaits when you enter a new biome

factors.name: 复活苏生
factors.description: 增加复活次数

factors.name: 神灯
factors.description: 每关都能额外遇到一个特殊房间
factors.descriptionEn: A bonus room in each level

factors.name: 天赋自助餐
factors.description: 选择天赋时增加2个选项

factors.name: 好运气
factors.description: 好运气

factors.name: 多重雕像
factors.description: 可以同时拥有多个雕像效果

factors.name: 无限能量
factors.description: 拥有无限能量

factors.name: 特卖日
factors.description: 神秘商人的特卖活动已开启

factors.name: 越战越勇
factors.description: 连续击杀怪物会让角色变得更强

factors.description: 所有武器自带一个配件
factors.descriptionEn: All weapons are equipped with attachments

factors.name: 生命恢复术
factors.description: 生命低于50%时自动回复

factors.name: 天赋异禀
factors.description: 额外获得3个天赋位置

factors.name: 疯狂匕首
factors.description: 暴击伤害增加

factors.name: 宠物巨大化
factors.description: 宠物巨大化，拥有更高的攻击力和攻击性
factors.descriptionEn: Pet is gigantic, more aggressive and deals higher damage

factors.name: 冷却减半
factors.description: 技能冷却时间减少50%
